ui_bugs.issue: Prefill useEffect (lines 414-438) lists `isGuided` and `isResponseDraft` in its dependency array before those `const`s are declared (lines 441-443). Because the dep-array is evaluated during render, this triggers a ReferenceError (temporal dead zone) as soon as any letter detail screen mounts, crashing situation-prefill AND the cross-tool import panel — i.e. exactly the two things this review asks us to verify.

rca of the issue: Mobile letter detail screen (letters/[id].tsx) declares a useEffect with dependency array `[entry, isGuided, isResponseDraft, id, draft]` on line 438, but the `const isGuided`/`isResponseDraft` are declared 3-5 lines LATER at 441-443. JavaScript `const` bindings are in the temporal dead zone until their declaration line executes, so evaluating the dep-array during render throws `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'isGuided' before initialization`. Fix: hoist those two consts to just above the useEffect (after `entry` state is available). Zero-risk change.
